headline: Sensex Jumps 898 Points as Banking and IT Stocks Drive Recovery Defying Global Selloff

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 driven by strong rallies in banking and IT stocks.
Nifty Bank scaled a new record high to lead the broader market recovery.
India's October core sector growth hit a new series high of 10.9% on robust coal and iron ore output.
Indian markets managed to buck the global sell-off despite early morning pressure from AI stock declines.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty opened lower in early trade before staging a sharp intraday turnaround.
Consumer-durable loans jumped 22% during Diwali, with rural India driving 58% of borrowing demand.
MobiKwik reported an 80% surge in Diwali payments to Rs 3,018 crore, led by Tier-2 cities.
Gold prices dropped to their lowest level of 2026 amidst broader market movements.
summary:
Indian equities staged a sharp recovery on November 20, 2026, with the Sensex surging 898 points and Nifty reclaiming the 25,800 mark.
The rally was led by banking and IT stocks, lifting Nifty Bank to a fresh record high and defying global market weakness.
Macroeconomic sentiment was bolstered by India's October core sector growth scaling a new high of 10.9%.
